v2-1768923178594-5x2m1y17v.name: Aethelgard
v2-1768923178594-5x2m1y17v.description: A serene and dreamlike realm where gravity-defying cities float above tranquil, cerulean waters, bathed in perpetual bright daylight.

v2-1768923178594-wi31ko5ff.name: The Azure Expanse
v2-1768923178594-wi31ko5ff.description: A vast, tranquil body of blue-green water upon which the floating city of Aethelgard is built.

v2-1768923178594-s0n665hx7.name: The Celestial Citadel
v2-1768923178594-s0n665hx7.description: An intricately designed stack of buildings, crafted from light-colored stone and reddish-orange brickwork, with numerous domed roofs, arched windows, balconies, and tall towers, soaring above the azure waters. A curved stone bridge with patterned surface extends outwards, and two large, spherical, clear blue glass orbs filled with water are featured beneath an arch and on the bridge.

v2-1768923227983-026pi06aj.name: The Celestial Citadel
v2-1768923227983-026pi06aj.description: A magnificent complex of buildings constructed from pale stone and rich reddish-orange brick, characterized by numerous domed roofs, arched windows, balconies, and soaring towers, all situated above shimmering azure waters. A gracefully curved stone bridge with an intricate surface leads to its entrance.
forbiddenTransformations: The Citadel should not appear as a modern architectural style.
The Citadel's structures should not be made of materials other than stone and brick.
The surrounding water should not be depicted as murky or polluted.
The sky should not be overcast or stormy.
The Citadel should not appear weathered or dilapidated.
The spherical water orbs should remain a consistent visual element.

v2-1768923227983-fxg72o138.name: Citadel Antechamber
v2-1768923227983-fxg72o138.description: You have entered a grand antechamber within the Celestial Citadel. The space is carved from the citadel's light-colored stone, leading deeper into its heart. Intricate architectural details hint at the grandeur of the structure.
forbiddenTransformations: The antechamber should not have exposed brickwork as a primary interior material; it should be stone-focused.
The ceiling should not be open to the sky or appear as a simple flat surface.
No visible signs of wear and tear or decay on the stone surfaces.
The space should not contain furniture incongruous with the citadel's aesthetic (e.g., modern seating).
There should be no direct sunlight, only reflected or ambient light.
The space should not feel cramped or utilitarian; it must retain a sense of grandeur.

v2-1768923283043-34pnyj7e2.name: Tower Top Chamber
v2-1768923283043-34pnyj7e2.description: This is a high chamber within one of the citadel's towers, offering a breathtaking panoramic view of the Azure Expanse and the surrounding architecture. The space is bathed in the bright midday sun, highlighting the ornate details of its construction.
forbiddenTransformations: The view from the windows showing anything other than the Azure Expanse and the citadel's architecture
Any indication of a ceiling that is not domed or vaulted
The presence of modern technology or furniture
Visible signs of wear or damage to the stone or brickwork
The introduction of any metallic or industrial materials
A lighting scheme that does not originate from the arched windows
The space feeling cramped or enclosed despite its height

v2-1768923518458-drbix64to.name: Ocean Dock Entrance
v2-1768923518458-drbix64to.description: This is the entry point from the ocean side of The Celestial Citadel. You stand on a sturdy, slightly damp stone platform where boats would moor. The scent of salt and the distant cries of seabirds fill the air.
forbiddenTransformations: the dock surface becoming made of wood
the citadel walls appearing to be made of metal
modern boat moorings being introduced
any visible pollution or debris from the water
the water orbs losing their glow
the citadel facade becoming weathered and grey
the sky turning overcast or dark

v2-1768924855781-g5iv2aoxw.name: The Celestial Ceiling
v2-1768924855781-g5iv2aoxw.description: View: Detailed carvings, potential celestial patterns, construction materials, and any unique architectural features of the domed ceiling.

v2-1768924989512-pux4tihah.description: Edit: add a crack in the ceiling

v2-1768925468085-5wdhw34p9.description: Edit: the ceiling start to crack

v2-1768942669683-xto80pph9.name: The Celestial Map Detail
v2-1768942669683-xto80pph9.description: View: Intricate details of the celestial map, including individual celestial bodies, cosmic patterns, fine carving work, and the textures of the ceiling material.

v2-1768942716279-8mmyj98xb.name: South America on the Map
v2-1768942716279-8mmyj98xb.description: View: Detailed cartography of South America on the map, including coastlines, mountain ranges, rivers, and any inscribed names or symbols.

v2-1768943076504-f731r8nmj.name: High Citadel View
v2-1768943076504-f731r8nmj.description: View: A sweeping aerial panorama of the Celestial Citadel, showcasing its entire structure, domed roofs, towers, the curved bridge, and the surrounding azure waters.

v2-1768943225981-w3p0gtjy3.name: Edited: set to night time, add glowing lights li...
v2-1768943225981-w3p0gtjy3.description: Edit: set to night time, add glowing lights like fires lightning up the citadel

v2-1768982657910-1okyeaq7g.name: Aethelgard
v2-1768982657910-1okyeaq7g.description: A world where forgotten aquatic metropolises slowly succumb to the embrace of the ocean, creating a serene yet melancholic beauty.

v2-1768982657910-ekjgh6oro.name: The Sunken District
v2-1768982657910-ekjgh6oro.description: The submerged remnants of a once-grand city, now a testament to time and the sea's gentle reclamation.

v2-1768982657910-kycxgo3wj.name: The Coral Pod
v2-1768982657910-kycxgo3wj.description: A large, partially submerged cylindrical module, encrusted with rocks and marine life, featuring circular openings revealing its derelict interior with remnants of furniture.

v2-1768982703786-g47y4gsd5.name: The Coral Pod
v2-1768982703786-g47y4gsd5.description: A large, partially submerged cylindrical module encrusted with rocks and marine life. Its circular openings hint at a derelict interior, a relic of Aethelgard's sunken city.
forbiddenTransformations: adding obvious signs of recent repair
introducing bright, modern technology
depicting clear, unobstructed views of the open sea from inside
showing intact, pristine furniture
removing marine encrustations from interior walls
depicting a dry, dusty environment

v2-1768982703786-6qh62zsw8.name: Main Chamber
v2-1768982703786-6qh62zsw8.description: The primary interior space of the Coral Pod, a cylindrical chamber carved into the module. Marine growth has crept inward, and remnants of furniture lie scattered, hinting at its former purpose.
forbiddenTransformations: visible sky or external views
bright, overhead lighting
clean, unbroken surfaces
fully intact furniture
dryness or dust
modern equipment
open doorways or windows leading outside

v2-1768982821546-nrgs8t5e5.name: The Red Bed Detail
v2-1768982821546-nrgs8t5e5.description: View: Close-up details of the red bed – the texture of the fabric, any wear or damage, the color saturation, and the surrounding marine growth encroaching upon it.

v2-1768982937797-afryp70gk.name: View from the Roof
v2-1768982937797-afryp70gk.description: View: The vast expanse of the sea, the hazy silhouettes of distant structures in the Sunken District, and the sky above, as seen from the highest vantage point of the Coral Pod.

v2-1768983077644-c92am5kir.name: Submerged Chamber
v2-1768983077644-c92am5kir.description: You have entered a sealed, submerged chamber within the Coral Pod. The air is heavy and still, with the faint sound of water pressure. Remnants of past habitation are visible, muted by the aquatic environment.

banned: any signs of healthy plant life

forbiddenTransformations: Any visible opening to the outside sea or sky.
Bright, clear, direct sunlight.
Modern, unweathered materials.
Lush, healthy plant or marine growth.
Signs of recent occupation or repair.
Any sounds of the bustling surface world.

v2-1768983122290-f1lhmewzv.name: Submerged Tunnel Chamber
v2-1768983122290-f1lhmewzv.description: You've entered a narrow, cylindrical tunnel carved into the Coral Pod's structure. Water laps at the floor, and the walls are slick with algae and encrusted with small shells. The tunnel leads deeper into the derelict module, hinting at further forgotten spaces.

banned: clear, unobstructed views of open sky

forbiddenTransformations: The tunnel walls are not smooth or clean; they must be encrusted and slick.
The water level should be present, indicating a submerged environment.
There should be no direct, bright sunlight shafts piercing the interior.
The space should not feel dry or airy; it is clearly within a water-logged structure.
The interior should not resemble a modern utility tunnel; it must feel derelict and organic.
The red rug and cushions should not be visible or referenced in this interior space.
The structure should not appear newly built or well-maintained.

v2-1768983321356-14u2g40b4.name: Ocean View Through Round Window
v2-1768983321356-14u2g40b4.description: View: The vast expanse of the ocean, waves, and the horizon seen through the round window.
